environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) running the gRPC UserService pod. Ingress is configured via AWS ALB Ingress Controller with gRPC target group. The ALB performs TLS termination using a server certificate from ACM but does NOT enforce client certificate authentication. The pod's Service is of type ClusterIP exposed through the ALB target group on port 50051. No Istio/Linkerd service mesh is deployed. Network policy allows any pod in the namespace to reach the service. External clients connect through the ALB's public endpoint.
